Observed existing anonymous-first YouTube auth fallback. Mixed explicit-429/auth/database messages previously triggered browser retries; RED/GREEN regressions now give surfaced rate limits priority without disabling ordinary fallback.

Observed GUI-affinity sequential queue and cancellation. RED/GREEN real Qt regression proved continued jobs after a surfaced limit; now remaining jobs are visibly not attempted, retained for explicit failed-only retry and never added to successful history.
